parole.testo: According to RBE, directly a Latin compound of acus (“needle”) + punctura (“pricking”). May be borrowed from a different European language and analyzed as an internationalism, or a learned borrowing from New Latin acūpūnctūra.
Internationalism, formally from New Latin vāsculāris (“related to vessel”) + -ен (-en) (standard extension of i-stem adjectives).
Learned borrowing from New Latin mōlēcula.
Internationalism, from New Latin nostalgia (see for further origin). Many cognates in other European languages, such as Russian носта́льгия (nostálʹgija), German Nostalgie, and French nostalgie.
Internationalism; compare French chronologie, German Chronologie, Russian хроноло́гия (xronológija) ultimately from New Latin chronologia, from Ancient Greek χρονολογία (khronología).
